def001_root_cause.root_cause: ROADMAP.yaml v2 depends_on ordering (the V2 resolver path), NOT the V1 backlog_refiller path. The v2 roadmap placed FACTORY_V2_RESHAPE_BENCHMARK_PROMOTION BEFORE FULL_CODEBASE_STATE_OF_ART_AUDIT in the dependency chain (it depended only on FOUNDATIONAL_LONG_RUN_TWITTER_RADAR, while the audit milestone additionally depended on the benchmark), so roadmap_resolver's topological sort selected the BENCHMARK milestone right after F2 settled; that milestone was not startable under the production gate configuration, so the supervisor went IDLE with an open roadmap. PROOF THE CAUSE IS V2-ORDERING AND NOT V1-BACKLOG_REFILLER: (1) the fix commit 829ceb991212ba94d30b5e0036fb9071804c01dd (2026-09-07 21:22) touches ONLY projects/factory/ROADMAP.yaml, PROJECT_STATE.json and SPEC.md -- zero lines of code -- and its diff states verbatim: 'Root cause of v2 defect: FACTORY_V2_RESHAPE_BENCHMARK_PROMOTION was placed BEFORE FULL_CODEBASE_STATE_OF_ART_AUDIT, inverting the canonical F3->F4->F5 order'; reordering a YAML DAG cannot repair a V1 queue-empty code path. (2) projects/factory/PROJECT_STATE.json records DEF-001 status=FIXED_ROADMAP_CORRECTED (observed_at 2026-09-07) -- the fix is the ROADMAP correction itself. (3) The V1 modules (backlog_refiller, autopilot, cto_planner, campaign_state) were still ALIVE in the tree until FACTORY_SIMPLIFY_S2/S4 (b671efe7889f / 2f5249abe3ca, 2026-09-13), i.e. 6 days AFTER the defect was observed and fixed -- if the V1 path had been the cause, the roadmap reorder could not have closed the defect while the V1 code was still present. The earlier attribution to backlog_refiller (2026-09-07 ledger prose, 'when queue emptied, showed no work despite open roadmap') is REFUTED and has been corrected in FACTORY_CONVERGENCE_LEDGER.json (update_2026_09_18). The test docstring of the regression test documents the same v2-ordering mechanism (tests/test_def001_premature_idle.py lines 12-14).
